title: FHA Appraisal Repairs: What Houston House Sellers Can Do
description: Did a buyer’s FHA lender require repairs? Find out what to ask for in writing, who may pay, and how to compare fixing the house with selling as-is.
primaryKeyword: FHA appraisal repairs when selling a house
supportingKeywords: who pays lender required repairs Houston
sell house as-is FHA appraisal repair
substantiveDifference: Addresses a lender property-condition requirement after an FHA appraisal, contract 7E cost responsibility, proof of completion and a comparison if repairs threaten timing. Existing appraisal article concerns a low valuation, repairs pages address general condition, and partial claim concerns the seller's payoff.
serviceGeography: Houston including verified local seller coverage
